meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析 Git 代码变更，找出修改的文件、受影响的组件和风险，并生成结构化分析报告。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 Git diff 或 Pull Request 时触发。

say.text: 分析当前分支的未提交变更。
分析这个 PR 的变更影响。
say.note: Claude 会获取 PR 的 diff 并分析影响范围。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes Git code changes to identify modified files, affected components, and risks, then produces a structured analysis report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze a Git diff or Pull Request.

say_en.text: Analyze uncommitted changes on the current branch.
say_en.note: Claude runs git diff --name-only to list changed files.

say_en.text: Analyze the impact of this PR.
say_en.note: Claude fetches the PR diff and analyzes the blast radius.
